stem.text: Which compound is chiral and reacts with $\text{Na}_2\text{CO}_3$ to give $\text{CO}_2$?

A.alt: Drawing of an alkene: a vertical C=C bond with H and CO2H on each carbon; both H atoms are on the same side (left) and both CO2H groups on the right, so the groups are cis to each other.

B.alt: Skeletal formula of a cyclohexene ring bearing a methyl group and an OH group on the same ring carbon, with a C=C in the ring at the lower right.

C.alt: Displayed formula: HCO2CH with CH2Br drawn above and CH3 drawn below the central carbon

D.alt: Displayed vertical chain: a carbon bearing Br and CO2H at the top, then CH2, then CH3 at the bottom
